worldcombat.skill.doubleteam.summary: Sidestep toward a chosen point and leave spaced one-hit decoy bodies at positions actually visited. Pursuers may turn on the old positions; hits on the real body still hurt normally.
worldcombat.skill.doubleteam.use.0: Leave images before focus fire, pulling damage onto them
worldcombat.skill.doubleteam.use.1: Speed away from a pursuit while the images soak the hits
worldcombat.skill.doubleteam.use.2: Buy a few seconds to reposition or withdraw
worldcombat.skill.doubleteam.description: The sidestep budget is about %1$s blocks; native obstacles shorten actual travel. A few decoys appear only at visited positions spaced far enough apart for their bodies to fit; a short path leaves fewer.

Decoys last %1$s and vanish when this identity is cleared. The caster gains 12%% movement speed (a brief surge) and keeps a lasting one-stage Pokemon evasion gain. Each decoy can be struck directly and broken.
Prepare for %1$s, recover for %2$s, and cool down for %3$s. Swarm leaves more lasting decoys with a shorter step; swift moves farther and faster with fewer decoys and extra speed.
Swarm: more copies, duration x1.25, travel x0.85, preparation +3 ticks and cooldown x1.2. Swift: fewer copies, duration x0.8, travel x1.15, preparation -2 ticks, cooldown x0.75 and extra speed.
The partner only considers leaving images while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for self-defence in melee, larger prepares from farther away.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to leave images.
